worktreesDirectory.description: Folder where new worktrees are created, on any drive, such as D:\worktrees or ~/worktrees. Existing worktrees stay where they are. Leave empty to use the T3 home folder.

cleanup.couldNotLoadLastRun: Could not load the last run.
cleanup.turnOnRuleHint: Turn on a cleanup rule to use this.

modeStatus.offlineMachines: Offline machines will not get this setting

scopeNotice.updateMachinesForProjectCleanup: Update the selected machines to configure project worktree cleanup.
scopeNotice.updateEnvironmentsForCleanup: Update the selected environments to use storage cleanup, or choose a machine that supports it.

worktreeCleanupMode.title: Automatic worktree cleanup
worktreeCleanupMode.descriptionOff: Keep this project's worktrees until you delete them manually.
worktreeCleanupMode.descriptionCustom: Use these rules for this project.
worktreeCleanupMode.descriptionInherit: Use each machine's worktree cleanup settings.

rules.deleteWithDeletedThreadsDescription: Remove unused worktrees when active or archived threads are deleted. Worktrees with local changes are kept.
rules.deleteInactiveDescription: Remove worktrees after their threads have been inactive for this many days. Branches and thread history are kept.
rules.deleteSettledDescription: Remove worktrees this many days after their thread settles. Set 0 days to remove them at the next cleanup. Branches and thread history are kept.
rules.deleteMergedDescription: Remove worktrees whose pull request is merged and whose commits are included in the default branch.
rules.deleteUnchangedDescription: Remove worktrees with no commits beyond the default branch.
rules.keepWhenTrackedChangesDescription: Deletes untracked and ignored files, including .env.
rules.keepWhenUncommittedChangesDescription: Keeps edits and untracked files. Deletes ignored files, including .env.

artifacts.deleteOldBrowserArtifactsDescription: Delete saved browser captures after this many days. Older capture links will no longer open.
artifacts.deleteOldRotatedLogsDescription: Delete inactive rotated log files after this many days. Current logs are kept.
